verified_facts.text: Alila Mayakoba is set in Mexico's Riviera Maya and combines two connected resort experiences, the Beach and the Lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in the heart of Mexico's Riviera Maya, Alila Mayakoba is defined by two distinct yet seamlessly connected luxury resort experiences.

verified_facts.text: The Beach side has a social, lively mood, anchored by a beach club, a taqueria and oceanfront dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Beach is Alila's Caribbean expression where the mood is social, vibrant and anchored by a lively beach club, taqueria and oceanfront dining.

verified_facts.text: The Lagoon side is a quieter, wellness-focused retreat of mangroves, Spa Alila and immersive culinary experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Lagoon is Alila at its purest, a nature-led, wellness-focused sanctuary where mangroves, Spa Alila and immersive culinary experiences create a slower, quieter and more intimate retreat.

verified_facts.text: Suites are decorated in subtle textures and soft neutrals, combining nature with sleek modern design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Subtle textures and soft neutrals are a balm for the senses, combining nature with sleek modernity.

verified_facts.text: The Beach Front Suite has a private plunge pool on its terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: The blue Caribbean beckons while you sink into the private plunge pool on the terrace of this 1,076-square-foot suite

verified_facts.text: The Beach Front Villa spans two floors, with nature-inspired decor and a private terrace with a plunge pool and beachfront views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Get comfortable in two floors of Mayakoba indulgence, with nature-inspired décor and a private terrace with a plunge pool and beachfront views.

verified_facts.text: The Alila Beach Front Presidential Suite is a three-bedroom, two-story suite with ocean views throughout.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spread out in your three-bedroom, two-story suite over 4,574 square feet, with ocean views throughout.

verified_facts.text: Wellness facilities include an authentic temescal steam lodge and a spa with treatments grounded in physical, mental and spiritual wellness.
verified_facts.excerpt: an authentic temescal steam lodge and a spa with treatments grounded in physical, mental and spiritual wellness

verified_facts.text: With traditional healers and spiritual guides, the resort offers cenote immersions, guided ceremonies and energy cleansings rooted in Mayan spirituality.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alongside traditional healers and spiritual guides, we offer destination cenote immersions, guided ceremonies, energy cleansings and more ancestral practices deeply rooted in Mayan spirituality

verified_facts.text: The Winds of Renewal journey leads to an open cenote for a Mayan water blessing.
verified_facts.excerpt: The trail unfolds into the light of an open cenote for a Mayan water blessing - a communion with the source of all renewal.

verified_facts.text: The Earth & Clay ritual centers on applying mineral-rich clay and honey.
verified_facts.excerpt: This ritual centers on the application of mineral-rich clay and honey

verified_facts.text: The Ixchel Water Blessing is a ritual using water, clay vessels, flowers and the ancestral chants of a Mayan healer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Through a gentle ritual utilizing soft elements like water, clay vessels, flowers and the ancestral chants of the Mayan healer

verified_facts.text: Alila Moments include outings from the resort to walk among villages and ancient ruins.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set out from our luxury resort in Riviera Maya and walk among villages and ancient ruins.

verified_facts.text: Casa Amate is a restaurant in a historic lagoon-side house that was once the residence of the De Leon family.
verified_facts.excerpt: Once the residence of the De León family, this historic lagoon-side property now houses a restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Na Cocina Local serves Yucatan cuisine from an open kitchen beside the lagoon, surrounded by mangroves.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beside the lagoon and surrounded by mangroves, the restaurant offers a contemporary take on the region

verified_facts.text: El Huerto/Chef's Atelier is a home-style kitchen beside an herb garden offering hands-on cooking and mixology.
verified_facts.excerpt: A thoughtfully appointed home-style kitchen sits beside a dedicated herb garden

verified_facts.text: Guests bringing a pet should inform the hotel at least three days before arrival.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please inform us that you will be bringing your pet (or pets) at least three days prior to your arrival.

verified_facts.text: Outdoor wellness sessions are subject to weather conditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our outdoor sessions are subject to weather conditions.

verified_facts.text: Winds of Renewal takes place off property.
